players.product: leading-edge wafer fab (N3/N2 GAA logic dies)

contracts.signal: Broadcom's 10-Q states that during the three fiscal quarters ended August 2, 2026 approximately 95% of the wafers manufactured by its contract manufacturers were produced by TSMC. The figure covers all wafers made for Broadcom by its contract manufacturers; the filing does not break it out by product line. Broadcom believes its wafer requirements represent a meaningful portion of TSMC's total production capacity and notes TSMC has raised its prices to manufacture Broadcom's wafers.
contracts.units: approximately 95% of wafers manufactured by Broadcom's contract manufacturers (all products)

players.product: custom AI XPU ASIC design, SerDes IP, and high-speed interconnect IP

quarterly_data.signal: Remaining performance obligations under certain multi-year customer contracts with firmly committed amounts (semiconductor solutions and infrastructure software segments) were approximately $179.2 billion as of August 2, 2026; they include obligations under a long-term contract for custom AI accelerators entered in the fiscal quarter ended May 3, 2026. Broadcom expects approximately 25% of this amount to be recognized as revenue over the next 12 months. The counterparty to the custom AI accelerator contract is not named.
quarterly_data.figure: RPO ~$179.2 billion (as of August 2, 2026), ~25% within 12 months

quarterly_data.signal: The 10-Q contractual commitments table shows unconditional purchase commitments totaling $126,821 million: $1,110 million for the remainder of fiscal 2026, $52,674 million in fiscal 2027, $72,952 million in fiscal 2028 and $85 million in fiscal 2029. Purchase commitments are enforceable obligations to purchase goods or services, primarily inventory, with fixed or minimum quantities, price provisions and approximate timing.
quarterly_data.figure: purchase commitments $126,821 million (fiscal 2026 remainder $1,110 million; 2027 $52,674 million; 2028 $72,952 million)

quarterly_data.signal: For the three fiscal quarters ended August 2, 2026, sales to distributors accounted for 56% of Broadcom's net revenue, and Broadcom believes aggregate sales through all channels to its top five end customers accounted for approximately 50% of net revenue. The customers are not named.
quarterly_data.figure: distributors 56%; top five end customers ~50% (three fiscal quarters ended August 2, 2026)
